notes.title: Version 0.5.0 - Map Remake & Gold Vaults
notes.content:
1. Add  new map Town : many NPC here, you can buy, sell and receive quests.
2. Change the way to get new tower : 
  - You can only get 3 tower from the main quest
  - You need to explore the world, find the silver chest and golden chest. But there chest are curse, you need to play a small game to open the chest, Each card open will take your HP or coins, and after open the chest, Disaster Level will increase.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033351/5a1b68efdefa73a4d42a12e2e108d66adfac4402.png[/img]
3. Remake most of map and change some tower.
4. After Disaster level 18, gold vaults will unlock. Go to the cave in the north to go to the gold vaults. Collect the relics from all over the world, then build and upgrade them in gold vaults. These relics may be buried in a big rock or reward from quest.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033351/86a2727fb0bf349739aec94344163eca59bd4f3f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Version 0.3.0 - King Monster
notes.content:
1. Raise the Disaster level limit to 59.
2. Great Disaster Wave will summon after level 40, with King Monster.
3. Add 7 new monsters, including King Monster.
4. King monster have million HP, and 3 abilities: 
- Summon some boss monster to attack the wall each 30 second
- Summon some boss monster or giant monster.
- Immune to stun, frozen or something... 
5. Add map gem mine.
6. Some small change and fix bugs

notes.title: Version 0.2.0 - Rare Tower and Rare Map
notes.content:
1. Add 12 new rare towers, each can upgrade to level 9,
2. Add some new quests, collect gems, and gain Upgraded Uncommon tech (allow Upgraded uncommon tower to level 9).
3. Ad Item Giant Monster Crystal, Giant Monster level 100+ have a small change to drop. Increase lucky also increase drop rate. This item is use no open 4 new maps.
4. Add new 4 maps :
 - Volcano: you get fire damage and burn over time, please buy some Cold Potions from the market.
 - Snow Mountain: you get ice damage and frozen points over time, please buy some Warm Potions from the market.
 - Thunder Mountain: you may be struck by thunder, please buy Electric Resistance Ring from the market.
 - Dead Forest: you get poison damage over time, please buy some Antidote from the market.
** These maps have a limit time.
5. Add many new resources : 
- Volcano: Titan Ore, Gem, Fire Crystal, Iron Crystal, Copper Crystal.
 - Snow Mountain: Titan Ore, Gem, Ice Crystal, Silver Crystal, Iron Crystal.
 - Thunder Mountain: Hard Marble, Gem, Electric Crystal, Gold Crystal, Copper Crystal.
 - Dead Forest: Hard Wood, Iron Wood, Poison Crystal, Green Crystal.
